**Coaching Note (80 words):**
When you have your queen centralized with checks available, look for moves that fork multiple pieces at once. Qe2+ here hits four pieces: both rooks, both bishops, and two pawns—all at the same time. Always scan for forcing moves (checks, captures) that hit more than one target.
